Starting the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots and documenting all findings.

I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. The detailed findings are documented in the attached report, along with screenshots capturing the various pages and issues identified.

### Key Takeaways:
- **Health Score:** 40/100. While the site looks visually appealing and navigation works well, there are significant data quality issues.
- **Critical Issues:** 
  - All upcoming MLB games show exactly 50%/50% probabilities.
  - The Open Championship (Golf) is marked as LIVE a month early and lists a squash player (Mostafa Asal) as the leader.
  - The known 100%/0% bug is still present, particularly in golf and some NBA prop markets.
- **Positive Aspects:** The Economics page, specifically the Fed rate heatmap, is exceptionally well-executed. Contextual tags on games (e.g., "Rivalry game") add great value for casual fans.

Please review the attached Markdown report and screenshots for the full details.
